# Customer Complaint Investigation & Resolution Memo
Escalation Review - Branch Operations

## Case Summary
- Case ID: CAS-88204-T9L2
- Date Logged: 03/12/2026
- Customer Name: Nadia Kowalczyk
- Account Number: Ending in 4108 (Preferred Checking)
- Supervisor: Lucas Holloway, Operations Support Supervisor

## Disputed Charges
| Date | Transaction Description | Posted Amount | Fee Assessed | Policy Category |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 03/05/2026 | Automated Clearing House (ACH) Utility Pmt | $240.00 | $35.00 | Paid Item Fee |
| 03/06/2026 | Outbound Domestic Wire Processing | $1,500.00 | $30.00 | Wire Service Fee |
| 03/08/2026 | Merchant POS Debit Card Purchase | $42.50 | $35.00 | Paid Item Fee |

## Investigation Findings
- Customer contacted Priority Line on 03/11/2026 disputing three fee charges totaling $100.00.
- Regarding the 03/05 ACH debit: The transaction created a negative ledger balance of -$18.40. Standard overdraft rules apply.
- Regarding the 03/06 wire: The customer initiated the wire online via the mobile portal. Under the Preferred Checking fee schedule, domestic mobile wires carry a $0.00 promotional charge for enrolled tiered members. System erroneously debited the standard $30.00 fee.
- Regarding the 03/08 debit card purchase: Customer never opted in to Regulation E overdraft coverage for everyday debit card transactions. Under Consumer Financial Protection Bureau rules, an overdraft fee cannot be assessed on one-time debit purchases without an affirmative opt-in agreement on file.

## Supervisory Action Plan
- Process a reversal credit of $35.00 for the valid ACH utility overdraft fee.
- Refund the improperly assessed $30.00 wire transfer fee back to account ending in 4108.
- Reverse the 03/08 unauthorized overdraft fee of $35.00 via Fee Code R-02.
- Mail formal Regulation E explanatory notice to the address on file by.
- Deliver closing call to Ms. Kowalczyk within 2 business days to review completed credits.
